text: Carlton, Greg from Harborline up in Boston. Easier to reach me here than email. Welcome aboard.
Appreciate it Greg. We mostly run Atlantic Seafood for fish but interested in your New England chowder base and steamers.
Good call. Our quahog chowder base ships frozen, 2-day to Astoria. I'll send the sheet.
Order #HL-1042 received: 4 cases chowder base. Est. delivery Thu.
Got the base in, quality's great. Clam chowder's been moving, cup and bowl both.
Glad to hear it. Steamers in season now if you want a trial case.
Send one case, we'll feature them as a weekend special.
Order #HL-1098 received: 1 case steamers. Est. delivery Sat.
Maeve, can we shift the Saturday drop to Friday this week? Big weekend.
No problem Carlton, Friday AM works. Driver's Brendan.
Greg, how's pricing looking heading into fall on the chowder base?
Holding steady through Q3. Small bump likely in Q4 with quahog supply tightening.
Understood. Lock me in at current rate for as long as you can.
Order #HL-1255 received: 6 cases chowder base. Est. delivery Thu.
Holiday season order coming, doubling the chowder base for December.
Noted. I'll prioritize your December drops. Happy holidays Carlton.
Order #HL-1390 received: 12 cases chowder base. Est. delivery Wed.
New year, same standing order on the base. Steamers when they're back in season.
Will do. Spring steamers usually late April, I'll ping you.
Steamers are in. Want your usual trial case for the weekend special?
Yes, perfect timing on the winter list. One case to start.
Order #HL-1502 received: 1 case steamers. Est. delivery Sat.
Greg, winter chowder volume looking strong. Keep the standing order going.
You got it. Best chowder account in Queens, ha. Talk soon.
